summary: [Square] capabilities: Orders: create/search/batch-retrieve/versioned-update/pay. Payments: createPayment (card on file/nonce), cancel/complete, refunds (full/partial), list/get. Terminal API for in-person checkouts. Customers CRUD, gift cards, loyalty. Disputes: accept returns funds to cardholder (debits seller, then bank). Invoices via API with payment links.
